confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on several consistent travel and price-index sources (Berlin 0.5 L Kneipe beer about EUR 2.50-4.00, cappuccino about EUR 3.97 in expat areas, inexpensive meals about EUR 10-15). Accommodation is lower confidence: sources disagree widely, and the 3-star figure is from an undated Skyscanner average and listing-based estimates. July is peak season, so I used upper-middle values. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor (cocktail about 3x beer, glass of wine about EUR 6) because direct evidence was weak. USD values use an assumed EUR/USD of 1.15, which I did not verify with a search. FX: the RBA exchange-rates page reported 0.6955 USD per AUD for 15 Oct 2026. The 16 Oct 2026 figure (0.6947) appeared in search output, but I could not confirm it was published by the 4 pm AEST fixing, so I used the 15 Oct value.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed. Anchors are based on Berlin-specific price evidence: restaurant and drink figures from cost-of-living comparison pages and Berlin guides, hostel figures from the Berlin tourism board and Hostelz price tables, and hotel figures from Skyscanner and Momondo averages plus individual Berlin listings.
